name: Monitor Google AI Overviews and Alert on Citation Gaps with Pangolinfo

parameters.content:
## Multi-query Google AI Overview visibility monitor

This production-oriented workflow audits several commercially important Google queries on a schedule. Pangolinfo retrieves the live AI Overview, citations, and organic results for each query. The workflow then scores brand visibility, checks whether a target domain is cited, detects weak organic positions, aggregates the portfolio, and emails the SEO team only when attention is required.

### Business outcome
- Monitor multiple queries in one execution
- Detect missing AI Overviews, brand mentions, and target-domain citations
- Score each query against configurable SEO/GEO thresholds
- Produce a ranked Markdown portfolio report
- Route only problem runs to an SMTP alert

This template uses the `n8n-nodes-pangolinfo` community node and therefore requires self-hosted n8n with community nodes enabled.

[AI Overview SERP API](https://www.pangolinfo.com/ai-overview-serp-api/) · [AI SERP Skill](https://www.pangolinfo.com/ai-serp-skill/) · [API documentation](https://docs.pangolinfo.com/en-api-reference/aiModeSerpApi/serpSubmit)

## 1. Configure the monitor

Edit only **Monitoring Configuration**:

- Put one Google query on each line.
- Set the brand or product name to find in AI Overview content.
- Set the domain that should appear in citations or organic results.
- Adjust the minimum visibility score and maximum acceptable organic position.
- Keep screenshots off for lower credit/storage usage, or enable them for visual evidence.
- Replace the example sender and recipient addresses.

Use **Test Workflow Manually** while configuring. Activate **Every Day at 08:00** only after a successful test.

## 2. Collect and score each query

**Prepare Search Jobs** turns the newline-separated query list into individual jobs and safely URL-encodes each Google search. The Pangolinfo node runs once per item.

**Score Citation Visibility** tolerates different SERP response layouts, extracts AI Overview content, source references, and organic results, then calculates a 0–100 score:

- 40 points: tracked brand appears
- 35 points: tracked domain is cited
- 15 points: AI Overview exists
- 10 points: tracked domain ranks within the configured limit

It also records human-readable reasons for every failed check.

## 3. Aggregate and alert

**Build Portfolio Report** combines all query-level checks into a ranked Markdown report, calculates the average score, and flags the execution when at least one query has an issue or the average falls below the configured threshold.

**Visibility Needs Attention?** routes only problem runs to **Email SEO Visibility Alert**. Connect an SMTP credential before activation. The healthy branch still returns a structured completion record for execution history.

You can replace the email node with Slack, Microsoft Teams, Jira, or your incident-management tool without changing the scoring pipeline.
